narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On May 3, 2024, Dallas County deputies executed a state arrest warrant at the subject's residence in Mesquite, Texas, for an unrelated theft charge, and the subject was booked into the Dallas County Jail. ICE Officer [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] interviewed him there on 05/04/2024 at approximately 1030 hours.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
An immigration judge in Dallas ordered the subject removed in absentia on 04/11/2017 after he failed to appear for his hearing. The subject stated that he did not know about the order.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is being presented for prosecution under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal.
DISPOSITION:
A detainer was lodged with the Dallas County Jail.
